heading: Evidence from the vehicle, shop, field, and prototype bench.
intro: These figures show the physical context behind the work. Open an image to inspect it at a larger size.

items.caption: Vehicle systems are built for inspection, track-side troubleshooting, and team execution—not just for a desk review.
A real subsystem is evaluated alongside the car, its interfaces, and the people who need to service it.
Industrial panel assembly reinforced the importance of drawings, wire routing, labelling, and quality checks.
Small-format course prototyping: physical packaging and iteration make design decisions visible quickly.
Early hands-on learning with lamination and fiberglass layups through a built composite deck.
Asset data and documentation are useful only when they support equipment, inspections, and operating decisions.
